principle: Drive repeat visits from BSS retail owners by publishing practical, evidence-backed item rankings and shareable owner-ready recommendations.

active_campaigns.objective: Turn weekly ranking into a shareable BSS owner message.

drafts.short_sms_or_kakao: 이번 주 Beauty Supply 매장에서 테스트할 만한 제품 순위를 정리했습니다. Trend evidence와 실제 supply URL을 분리해서 볼 수 있습니다: https://gnsresearchhub.vercel.app/rankings/weekly.html?utm_source=message&utm_medium=direct&utm_campaign=daily-visits-500-weekly-stock-test
drafts.x_twitter: Beauty Supply owners: this week’s item ranking is built to answer one question — what should I test on the floor now? Evidence links, supply validation, and watchlist items are separated clearly. https://gnsresearchhub.vercel.app/rankings/weekly.html?utm_source=x&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=daily-visits-500-weekly-stock-test
drafts.instagram_caption: 이번 주 BSS 매장에서 바로 테스트할 수 있는 item ranking을 업데이트했습니다. Trend claim과 supply validation을 분리해서, owner가 과장 없이 display/reorder test를 판단할 수 있게 정리했습니다. Link in bio / weekly ranking.
drafts.sales_rep_note: Owner님, 이번 주 손님들이 반응할 만한 item을 product-level로 정리했습니다. 단순 trend가 아니라 실제 source/evidence와 display tip까지 같이 보실 수 있습니다.

experiment_backlog.hypothesis: Retail action language will increase ranking CTA and item-card clicks versus evidence-first language.
experiment_backlog.next_measurement_need: Central analytics provider to compare variant exposure and click events across sessions.

experiment_backlog.hypothesis: Owner-facing copy that says 'what to test this week' will generate more repeat visits than generic trend wording.
experiment_backlog.next_step: Create social/email/share snippets per top weekly item once SNS/email credentials and approval rules are defined.

permission_requests: Enable/connect a central analytics provider: Vercel Web Analytics, GA4, Plausible, or PostHog.
Provide SNS channel decision and credentials for approved posting: X/Twitter via xurl, Instagram/Facebook via Meta/Buffer, TikTok/LinkedIn if desired.
Define posting rule: draft-only, approval-first, or auto-post within strict limits.
Optional: choose/register a custom domain for better trust and repeat visits.
Optional: define paid marketing budget cap and stop-loss rule before any ad spend.
